business_problem: Yum China had reached the limits of small-model online customer service and needed more flexible dialogue handling for delivery-status, ordering and other high-volume restaurant-service scenarios.
solution_summary: Yum China upgraded its digital customer-service stack with Baidu AI Cloud so restaurant support could move beyond rigid FAQ flows. The new system is built around Baidu AI Cloud Keyue and adds large-model intent recognition and multi-turn dialogue to existing knowledge-driven support. In operation, requests from the app, mini-programs and food-delivery platforms are routed into the AI service layer, which identifies intent, keeps the context of the conversation and responds more flexibly than the earlier small-model system. Complex scenarios such as催单 are where the change matters most: the assistant now uses context and user state to produce a specific resolution rather than a generic scripted answer. This makes the platform a conversation engine for very high-volume restaurant-service interactions, one that both improves customer self-service and lowers handoff to human agents across multiple digital channels.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Customer Service
solution_components.role: Provides the main automated support surface across Yum China's consumer channels.

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Keyue
solution_components.role: Acts as the conversational platform used to upgrade Yum China's customer-service system.

solution_components.name: Multi-Turn Dialogue
solution_components.role: Keeps context across longer service conversations and improves response flexibility.

solution_components.name: Intent Recognition
solution_components.role: Identifies consumer requests accurately before downstream response generation.

data_flow: Consumer requests from apps, mini-programs and delivery platforms enter the Keyue-based service layer, where intent recognition and multi-turn dialogue generate responses and route unresolved issues away from manual service channels only when needed.
business_outcome: Yum China raised answer quality and self-service resolution rates while lowering the cost of handling large-scale digital customer-service traffic across restaurant brands.
metrics: The system handles more than 150,000 customer interactions per day.
